summary: Frontend-only test of the Guardian Journey truthfulness batch on the Expo web preview (375x667), logged in as voicetest2026@example.com, using fake 900000000x numbers only. What works: guardian-share lists one row per contact; only contacts with notifications on AND a phone number appear. Prepare opens exactly ONE sms: URL for that contact only (no comma-joined list) and the row shows the tick plus 'Message prepared — press Send in your SMS app'. The banner says 'Message prepared for 1 person … DHARA cannot confirm delivery' and never says notified or sent. The 112 contact is blocked ('Blocked for your safety / SMS to an emergency-service number is blocked…'), no sms: is opened and the row is not marked prepared. Wording is correct: gpsLive=0 gives 'Check my journey status', gpsLive=1 gives 'Track my journey live', and a create failure puts '(Status link unavailable…' in the SMS body. The status-link host is https://dhara-shield-2.preview.emergentagent.com; guardian-link-host-warning is not shown, and the code would show it for localhost, 127.0.0.1, 10.x, 192.168.x and 172.16-31.x. Failure states work: with the request aborted or returning 500, mark-safe shows guardian-safe-error + guardian-safe-retry with no safe banner, and revoke shows guardian-revoke-error + guardian-revoke-retry with no withdrawn banner. Retrying mark-safe after removing the block succeeded. Empty and non-messageable states show guardian-no-contacts, and guardian-add-circle goes to /women/trusted-circle. GPS consent order: no navigator.geolocation call happens before or after the consent tap on web, because useJourneyGPS skips web entirely. After the user taps 'Allow for this journey', head-out passes gpsLive=0 on web, which is correct. 'I'm home safely' sends PATCH /safe and ends the session. Guardian page with temp_location=false: destination, area and coordinates are hidden, and after mark-safe it shows 'Arrived safely' with no location. BUT after revoke only, it wrongly shows 'Journey in progress · LIVE' with '—' timestamps (see the frontend bug below). Regression: Silent Alert opens an sms: link only on tap. The 112 dialler opens only on tap and shows 'DHARA has not placed a call'. The Family Journey hub and the Evidence Locker PIN gate load. Head Out Google Places autocomplete, details and the map work. No sms: or tel: URL opened automatically on any screen load. Not verifiable on web: the native permission prompt order, the deny fallback and the watch stop. These were checked by reading the code only.

minor.issue: When sharing is revoked without mark-safe, the closed response returns status='in_progress' (plus closed_at). The frontend uses status alone to tell active from closed, so the revoked journey renders as active. Adding an explicit 'closed': true or 'sharing_revoked' flag would make the contract unambiguous. Pre-existing; backend was not changed in this batch.

ui_bugs.issue: After the owner taps Withdraw sharing (revoke only, not safe), the guardian view shows the ACTIVE card with the 'LIVE' badge, 'Journey in progress' and '—' for the start and check-in times, instead of the 'Sharing has ended' closed card. Location stays hidden, but the screen falsely claims the journey is live. This breaks the owner rule 'never claim live unless true'. RCA: active vs closed is decided only by json.status === 'in_progress', and a revoked journey still has status 'in_progress'. Fix: treat the response as closed when json.closed_at !== undefined or started_at is missing.

After POST /api/journey/status fails, the on-screen 'Message preview' still reads 'Check my journey status: [status link will be added]', while the SMS actually prepared says '(Status link unavailable — …)'. The preview does not match what is sent and implies a link will exist. Before the first Prepare, the preview also always promises a link. Fix: when createError is set, call buildMessage(null) for the preview. Reference: app/women/guardian-share.tsx:320

If Withdraw sharing failed and mark-safe later succeeds, guardian-revoke-error and guardian-revoke-retry stay visible under the 'arrived safely' banner. The withdraw section itself is hidden by then. This invites a pointless retry. Clear revokeError when markedSafe becomes true, or hide that block. Reference: app/women/guardian-share.tsx:418

On web, or whenever useJourneyGPS sets an error, the row says 'Starting location tracking…' forever after Allow. gps.error ('GPS not available in web preview') is never shown. The label implies tracking will start when it will not. Reference: app/women/head-out.tsx:480-484

The LIVE badge shows on the active card even when temp_location=false and no location is shared. Consider wording such as 'Active' to avoid implying live tracking. Reference: app/guardian/[token].tsx (active card header)

issues: safeBtn has no paddingHorizontal: inside the centred empty card the 'Manage circle' button shrinks to its text width, so the text touches the button border (guardian-add-circle).
At 375px width, the 'I have arrived safely — update my guardian' label runs to the button edge (guardian-mark-safe).
The create-failure message (createError) has no testID, which makes it hard to automate.
At 375px width, the 'Notify your guardian' button label nearly overflows the pill (headout-notify-guardian).
The consent button 'Allow for this journey' is about 32px tall (paddingVertical 7, fontSize 12), below the 44px touch-target minimum (gps-allow-btn).
The floating 'Help' FAB overlaps the footer text 'You can see this journey because QA added you…' on a 375x667 screen.

react_native_issues.issue: subRef.current = await Location.watchPositionAsync(...) runs after the effect may already have been cleaned up, for example when the session ends while the permission prompt or getCurrentPosition is still pending. 'cancelled' is not re-checked after the await, so that watch is never removed and location watching continues after 'I'm home safely'. Fix: after the await, if cancelled then call sub.remove() and return. Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useJourneyGPS.ts:161

action_items: HIGH: app/guardian/[token].tsx:131: decide closed vs active by closed_at or sharing_revoked, not only by status === 'in_progress'. A revoked journey currently shows 'LIVE / Journey in progress'.
MEDIUM: guardian-share preview: after a create failure, render buildMessage(null) so the preview shows '(Status link unavailable…' exactly like the prepared SMS. Add a testID to the createError text.
MEDIUM: useJourneyGPS.ts:161: re-check 'cancelled' after await watchPositionAsync and remove the subscription, so watching always stops when the session ends.
LOW: clear revokeError once markedSafe is true.
LOW: show gps.error in the head-out GPS row instead of an endless 'Starting location tracking…'.
LOW: add paddingHorizontal (≥16) to safeBtn, and make gps-allow-btn ≥44px tall.
critical_code_review_comments: guardian-share.tsx createJourneyRecord useCallback reads statusUrl but leaves it out of its deps. This is harmless today because prepareFor checks statusUrl first, but it is fragile.

If one Prepare fails to create a link and a later Prepare succeeds, contacts can receive different messages: one with '(Status link unavailable' and one with a link. Consider a visible 'Retry creating link' action.

Silent Alert opens a real sms: composer, because OUTBOUND_MODE=live and PROFILE=production, even though EXPO_PUBLIC_ALERT_SIMULATION_MODE=true. That flag appears to cover only the head-out sim preview. This is pre-existing and user-initiated; flagged so the owner knows.

rca_of_issue: Revoked guardian view shows LIVE: the backend closed branch (journey_router.py ~L502) returns {access_level, status, closed_at, traveller_display}. For a revoke-only journey, status stays 'in_progress'. The frontend (guardian/[token].tsx:131) maps status === 'in_progress' to kind 'active' and so renders the LIVE active card with empty dates. Repro: create a journey with an accepted recipient link, then POST /revoke, then open /guardian/<token> as the recipient. Mitigation: branch on 'closed_at' in json.
